queries.name: interseccion_faltantes
queries.sql:
WITH productos AS (
    SELECT ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
),
insumos AS (
    SELECT ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.CodigoFuente IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_producto,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.CodigoFuente IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_insumo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.CodigoFuente IS NULL
              AND i.CodigoFuente IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_ambos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.CodigoFuente IS NOT NULL
              AND i.CodigoFuente IS NOT NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ambos_vinculados
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN productos p
  ON p.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND p.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND p.CodigoFuente = r.ProductoCodigoFuente
LEFT JOIN insumos i
  ON i.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType
ORDER BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType

queries.name: costos_cero_por_actividad
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    SystemType,
    Activo,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_unitario_cero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoTotal = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_total_cero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario < 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_unitario_negativo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoTotal < 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_total_negativo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_unitario_nulo
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, Activo
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType, Activo

queries.name: consistencia_matematica
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN
        ABS(
            CONVERT(decimal(28,6), Cantidad)
            * CONVERT(decimal(28,6), CostoUnitario)
            - CONVERT(decimal(28,6), CostoTotal)
        ) > 0.01
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diferencias_mayores_centavo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN
        ABS(
            CONVERT(decimal(28,6), Cantidad)
            * CONVERT(decimal(28,6), CostoUnitario)
            - CONVERT(decimal(28,6), CostoTotal)
        ) > 1.00
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diferencias_mayores_peso
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
WHERE CostoUnitario IS NOT NULL
  AND CostoTotal IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

queries.name: costo_receta_vs_insumo
queries.sql:
WITH insumos AS (
    SELECT
        ServerID,
        SystemType,
        CodigoFuente,
        MAX(Costo) AS Costo,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS registros
    FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
    GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, CodigoFuente
)
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), r.ServerID) AS ServerID,
    r.SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.CodigoFuente IS NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sin_insumo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.registros = 1
              AND i.Costo IS NOT NULL
              AND r.CostoUnitario IS NOT NULL
              AND ABS(i.Costo - r.CostoUnitario) > 0.01
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_diferente,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.registros = 1
              AND i.Costo IS NOT NULL
              AND r.CostoUnitario IS NOT NULL
              AND ABS(i.Costo - r.CostoUnitario) <= 0.01
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_equivalente
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas r
LEFT JOIN insumos i
  ON i.ServerID = r.ServerID
 AND i.SystemType = r.SystemType
 AND i.CodigoFuente = r.ComponenteCodigoFuente
GROUP BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType
ORDER BY r.ServerID, r.SystemType

queries.name: unidades_medida_componentes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    SystemType,
    UnidadMedida,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS componentes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoUnitario = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_cero
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Recetas
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType, UnidadMedida
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType, UnidadMedida

queries.name: cobertura_costos_insumos
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CONVERT(varchar(36), ServerID) AS ServerID,
    SystemType,
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS insumos,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Costo = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_cero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Costo < 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS costo_negativo,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CostoPromedio = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promedio_cero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UltimoCosto = 0
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ultimo_cero,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Activo = 1
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activos
FROM dbo.Sync_Productos_Insumos
GROUP BY ServerID, SystemType
ORDER BY ServerID, SystemType

objective: Auditar preparacion para reconciliacion de costos POS: faltantes de producto e insumo, costos cero, consistencia matematica y diferencias de costo. Exclusivamente lectura.
